description: HF linear response on helium: static and dynamic (0.05 au) alpha_zz at one rung (protocol 1e-4, k 6). Row order in response_properties.alpha follows dipole.frequencies. The response block sets dconv 1e-4 explicitly: left unset it derives to 100*thresh = 0.01, and since the FD gate is bsh < 5*dconv that let the solve stop at bsh 1.6e-3 after 4 iterations. At dconv 1e-4 the gate is 5e-4 and the two legs converge at bsh 4.9e-7 (static) and 1.1e-5 (0.05 au) in 6 iterations. Reference: RelWithDebInfo, TBB, 1 rank x 7 threads, Seawulf Milan long-96core-shared, 2026-09-21, commit 80e89f829 (job 2193424), wall 10 s. alpha tol 1e-3 (absolute, au) is a floor far above the run-to-run spread, not an accuracy claim.
